dock:character/character.note: Upstream's Character section (type_sections), the one implementation shared with the Properties panel and the Type options bar (useTypeStyle): font, style, size and leading (as the layer's transform shows them), kerning (Metrics, Optical, or a value, typed or picked) and tracking, vertical and horizontal scale, baseline shift and colour, and the faux styles (Faux Bold, Faux Italic, All Caps, Small Caps, Underline, Strikethrough), each type.setStyle on the active type layer, a field's drag one history step. Without a type layer, upstream's hint shows; the Type tool's own options (font, style, size) and the foreground stay editable for new type, the rest disabled. New type takes the tool's font, style, size, and alignment and the foreground, as upstream's Type tool sends them, and everything else from Type › Save Default Type Styles.

followUps.item: Edit the next type's character and paragraph settings from the Character and Paragraph panels while no type layer is active, backed by the engine's default type styles (Session::type_defaults, which no query exposes yet)
Kerning at the caret and the style of a selected range while type is edited in place (upstream's kerning_at and range targets), once the web editor edits type layers in place
Recolour the selected characters when the foreground changes while type is edited in place (upstream's type_tool::foreground_changed)

dock:character/paragraph.note: Upstream's Paragraph section (type_sections), shared with the Properties panel: the seven alignments with upstream's glyphs, left, right, and first-line indents, space before and after, and Hyphenate, each type.setStyle on the active type layer's paragraphs. Without a type layer, upstream's hint shows and only the Type tool's alignment (left, center, right) can change, for new type.

dock:color/color.note: Upstream's Photoshop-theme Color panel (color_field): the foreground and background chips (a click picks which colour the field edits, framed) and Kit UI's colour picker (saturation and brightness field and hue strip, 120 px as upstream's, with hex and R, G, B fields). The colours live in the engine's session (session.inspect, tools.setColors), shared with the rail's chips, X and D, the Eyedropper, Swatches, and new type, and, as upstream's one session keeps them, shared by every Photo tab and kept between documents (Kit UI's kit store, kit:kit.photo:colors, followed through storage events; a tab stores only what it set or its own engine changed, so it never writes an older colour back); no change is a history step.

followUps.item: Upstream's Color Picker dialog, opened by double-clicking a chip in the Color panel or clicking one in the toolbar (the rail's chips open the browser's picker until then)

Upstream's dock icon column left of the panel groups (a group collapsed to its icon, its icon click expanding or collapsing it, dock::rail_click): Kit UI's DockArea collapses a group to its tab strip only, and an icon strip needs it to lay groups out in two columns with per-group icons, a shared DockArea change

dock:color/gradients.reason: A library panel (gradient and pattern presets, actions, layer comps) with its own dialogs (Gradient Editor, New Action, New Layer Comp): the engine has its commands; the panel comes with wave 2's dialogs. The tab says it comes later.

dock:color/patterns.reason: A library panel (gradient and pattern presets, actions, layer comps) with its own dialogs (Gradient Editor, New Action, New Layer Comp): the engine has its commands; the panel comes with wave 2's dialogs. The tab says it comes later.

dock:color/swatches.note: The engine's swatch library (swatches.list) in upstream's ten-column grid, by group: a click sets the foreground, a right-click the background (swatches.use), and the footer adds the foreground as a swatch (swatches.add) or deletes the swatch last clicked (swatches.delete). The library is shared by every Photo tab and kept between documents, as upstream saves it: its Adobe Swatch Exchange bytes (swatches.export, swatches.import replace) in Kit UI's kit store (kit:kit.photo:swatches), up to 256 KB; a larger library stays with its tab, which says so once. No history step.

followUps.item: The Swatches panel menu: new group, rename, move, reset, import and export (swatches.newGroup, swatches.rename, swatches.move, swatches.reset, swatches.import, swatches.export)

dock:history/actions.reason: A library panel (gradient and pattern presets, actions, layer comps) with its own dialogs (Gradient Editor, New Action, New Layer Comp): the engine has its commands; the panel comes with wave 2's dialogs. The tab says it comes later.

dock:history/history.note: The snapshot row (the bottom layer's thumbnail and the document's name), every state with upstream's icons, those Redo steps through dimmed (`historyRedo` from inspect), a click going to a state in one command (history.goTo), and Delete current state once confirmed (history.deleteState). Create new document from current state is hidden: history.newDocument opens a second document in the engine, which the web editor cannot show (the host opens documents). Create new snapshot is drawn disabled, as upstream's button does nothing.

followUps.item: History snapshots: the engine keeps none yet (history_cmds.rs), so Create new snapshot stays disabled

dock:history/layerComps.reason: A library panel (gradient and pattern presets, actions, layer comps) with its own dialogs (Gradient Editor, New Action, New Layer Comp): the engine has its commands; the panel comes with wave 2's dialogs. The tab says it comes later.

dock:layers/channels.note: Composite, color, layer mask, alpha, and Quick Mask rows with thumbnails and eyes; target, Cmd-click to load, rename, the row menu (overlay color and opacity presets, Split and Merge Channels left out), and the footer.

dock:layers/layers.note: Upstream's Layers panel: kind filter and name search, blend mode, Opacity, locks, Fill, rows with eyes (Alt: show only), 34 px thumbnails in 44 px rows (an adjustment's glyph tile beside its mask, a type layer's T tile), the name (the Background's in italics) over its kind (an adjustment's name, Type, Shape, a group's layer count), masks (mask target), rename, folding groups, effects rows, multi-select, drag to reorder or onto the footer, the row menu, and the footer. Layer styles open the generic command dialog until wave 2's Layer Style dialog.

dock:layers/paths.note: Saved paths, the work path, and the layer's path with outlines; select, rename, save the work path, the row menu, and the footer. A selected saved path is not drawn on the canvas yet.

dock:navigator/histogram.note: Upstream's Histogram panel (tone.rs histogram_panel): the composite's histogram from the engine's histogram extra (RGB as the mean of the channels, Red, Green, Blue, and Luminosity, which Photoshop's panel lists), drawn as upstream's draw_histogram draws it (raw bins, scaled to the 251st-smallest bin with 10 % headroom), with Mean, Std Dev, Median, Pixels, and Cache Level (the extra's own sampling: the whole factor that brings the image within 1024 pixels); computed at most every 250 ms while the image changes, a new channel at once, one request at a time, only while the tab shows, the warning triangle showing while it lags.

dock:navigator/info.note: Upstream's Info panel: R, G, B and naive device C, M, Y, K of the composite pixel under the pointer (document.sampleColor, at most once per animation frame, one request at a time, the last answer showing until the next), the pointer's X and Y wherever it moves over the canvas (also while Space or the Hand tool pans, Kit UI's track and leave), the selection's W and H in the ruler unit (prefs unitsAndRulers), and the document's size.

dock:navigator/navigator.note: Upstream's Navigator: the whole image from the engine's navigatorImage extra (rendered from a reduced copy, about 46 ms for a 3000 x 2000 image at 640 px where a full composite took 440 ms; at most every 250 ms while it changes, one request at a time, only while the tab shows) over a checkerboard, the canvas's visible area outlined, a press or drag centring the canvas there (as upstream sets the view's centre), and Zoom with Fit, 100 %, 200 %, and the log2 zoom slider from 1 % to 3200 %.

dock:properties/adjustments.note: Upstream's sixteen adjustment-layer buttons with their icons and tooltips, each layer.newAdjustmentLayer.<kind> through the mask target's session (the engine masks the new layer with the selection); the Properties tab then shows its settings.

dock:properties/properties.note: Document (canvas W and H with link, orientation, resolution, mode, bit depth), layer header, then in upstream's order (properties_body, layer_controls): the layer's X, Y, W, and H read only, Opacity and Fill as slider rows, a type layer's Character, Paragraph, and Type Options sections (upstream's type_properties, the same sections as the Character and Paragraph panels), a shape's Appearance (colour fills and strokes; none, gradient, and pattern paints show by name) and live Shape, then Align and Distribute and Quick Actions (upstream's Photoshop theme's); an adjustment layer's settings as slider rows (upstream's slider_row; Levels' five numbers as plain fields, as upstream's value_field), drop-downs, and check boxes (visible, clip, reset; Levels shows its composite's five numbers). The canvas Fill drop-down is left out: upstream's has one choice and does nothing.

followUps.item: Levels editor in Properties: histogram, input and output sliders, per-channel levels, auto
Curves editor in Properties: the curve graph, its points, per-channel curves
Hue/Saturation's hue-range bar (dragging a range's four bounds)
Gradient Map's gradient stop editing (colour, location, add, remove)
Live-adjust preview: adjustment fields preview while dragged and commit one step on release (upstream's app.live_adjust); wave 1 writes on every drag tick, coalesced into one step
Shape fill and stroke type picker (none, solid, gradient, pattern)
Rulers & Grids section in the Document view (needs the canvas to draw rulers and grids)
Guides section in the Document view (needs the canvas to draw guides)

options:Type/dropdown:type-aa.note: Deliberate deviation: new type is created with the bar's anti-aliasing (type.create antialias), so it matches what the bar shows. Upstream (type_tool::pointer_up) runs type.edit only when its option is not Sharp, so its default Sharp leaves the engine's Smooth on new type, which looks like an upstream bug.

tool:Count.reason: Runs count.add, but the canvas does not draw count marks yet; count marks come with the canvas extras (View › Show) in wave 3.

tool:Note.reason: Runs notes.add, but the canvas does not draw notes yet; notes come with the canvas extras (View › Show) in wave 3.

tool:Ruler.reason: Runs image.analysis.rulerTool, but the canvas does not draw the ruler line yet; the ruler line comes with the canvas extras (View › Show) in wave 3.

tool:Slice.reason: Runs slice.new, but the canvas does not draw slices yet; slices come with the canvas extras (View › Show) in wave 3.

tool:SliceSelect.reason: Runs slice.set, but the canvas does not draw slices yet; slices come with the canvas extras (View › Show) in wave 3.
